_readme: [QixiRomance2022 2026-10-15] Romantic Season (Global Qixi 2022) config, read by Base\QixiRomance2022\QixiRomance2022Ui.cs (re-read when the file changes). Item strings use the official client format 'id 0 count monopoly saveMinutes active' (monopoly 3 = bound). OFFICIAL = client data (luagui\1267.dat, Server_Key tTanabataFestivalNpc / tQixiFestivalCross2022, itemtype). DERIVED = chosen here because the number is server-side only.
_repairStep: DERIVED: % per repair. The client's own default in DlgQiXiFestival_MessageTip is 4 ('tParam[4] or 4') -> 25 repairs per part, 100 materials for the whole harp.
_points: DERIVED Love Points per repair / maintenance / Holy Plectrum played (the free daily song counts as 1 plectrum).
_songCost: OFFICIAL DlgQiXiFestivalRepair:SetXiaoHaoCountText (First Love 1, Sunny Day 3, Sweet Hugs 10); the 1st First Love play of the day is free (luaUiRes[1267][13]).
_oneKeyMax: DERIVED: most materials one 'Maintain all' click uses (bag space is checked for every reward).
_repairPool: ITEMS OFFICIAL Dialog_Info['1267-preview-award'] (repair/maintain reward preview); WEIGHTS DERIVED (Silk is the advertised repair reward, luaUiRes[1268][6] point 5).
_songPools: ITEMS + AMOUNTS OFFICIAL Dialog_Info['1267-award-pool'] [1] First Love [2] Sunny Day [3] Sweet Hugs (the strings must stay identical: the window highlights the won slot by string equality). WEIGHTS DERIVED.
_milestones: OFFICIAL Server_Key tTanabataFestivalNpc[30788][Text314-319] (Love Point Rewards). NOT GIVEN: the 50000 Qixi Title [The Little Prince/The Rose] (no title id for it in title_type.txt).
_overflow: OFFICIAL Text321 'after 50000, every 1600 points: 1 L1 Mythsoul and 1 Apollo`s Blessing'. DERIVED item: L1 Mythsoul Pack 3325756 for 'L1 Mythsoul'.
_rankMin: OFFICIAL Text428 'Collect at least 5000 Love Points to get ranked on the local rankings.'
_flowerDailyLimit: OFFICIAL tTanabataFestivalNpc[30789][Text233] '(%s/150)' flower/gift items per day.
_flowers: OFFICIAL Orphee tTanabataFestivalNpc[30789][Text224-227] tips: Tulip/Jade 1x9 3x3 9x1 99x1=11; Orchid/Beer, Lily/Love Letter, Kiss/Red Rose 1x20 3x7 9x2 99x1=5 999x1=50 (no single Lily row). Item ids = itemtype 751xxx-758xxx. DERIVED: the material given is the one of the harp part being repaired (a random one of the 4 once the harp is whole).
_repairPack: Ethereal Harp Repair Pack 3336393: OFFICIAL contents (1 Phoenix Wood / Fairy Flower / Whale Baleen / Mermaid Tear), DERIVED equal odds.
_performancePack: Harp Performance Pack 3336415: OFFICIAL 1/2/3/5 Holy Plectrums, DERIVED odds.
_memoryPack: Orphee Memory Pack 3336366: OFFICIAL 1-5 Holy Plectrums, DERIVED odds.
